crime.value: Extortion and protection racket scheme targeting Montevideo taxi drivers, implemented through staged violence (cab bombing, brake tampering, assault) to coerce payment; central question: how will the taxi association respond to threats from 'The Big Ones'?
crime.quote: Each member of your association will pay The Big Ones, through me, a small percentage of his earnings. In return. The Big Ones will see to it that nothing of a violent nature happens to your taxi drivers

victim.value: Montevideo Taxicab Drivers Association membership (hundreds of drivers); vulnerable because they are economically dependent on daily earnings and geographically dispersed, making collective defense difficult
victim.quote: How will he now provide for his family? Diego has twelve children, Fernando. And only one good arm.

closed_world.value: Montevideo taxi driver community—a bounded professional association with shared infrastructure, meeting spaces, and economic interdependence; drivers cannot escape the jurisdiction or avoid the threat
closed_world.quote: The Montevideo Taxicab Drivers Association... A powerful brotherhood with hundreds of members

culprit_and_motive.value: Fernando Quintana (taxi secretary) and Manoël (out-of-work actor), who engineered the entire 'Big Ones' deception to extort monthly protection payments; motive is financial gain—'a regular monthly income, a delicious succession of small fortunes'
culprit_and_motive.quote: we have, instead, a regular monthly income, a delicious succession of small fortunes, one a month, to be enjoyed for years to come

resolution.value: No resolution present in excerpt. The scheme succeeds; the membership votes to pay, and Manoël demands a renegotiated split (75/25 instead of 75/25). The text ends with Fernando planting explosives in Manoël's car, suggesting violent elimination of the co-conspirator.
resolution.quote: I went out and hunted up his battered Volvo in the Carasco parking lot and wired enough plastic explosive under its dashboard to blow a dozen Volvos and their occupants into tiny bits

investigator.value: Fernando Quintana, taxi association secretary and insider-narrator; he experiences the mystery from the perpetrator's perspective, not as an investigator but as an accomplice-narrator revealing the scheme in retrospect
investigator.quote: I called Carlos Olavide, the head of our Drivers Association, from the Sisters of Mercy Hospital in Montevideo.
